description: 401 Unauthorized means "I do not know who you are" (send credentials); 403 Forbidden means "I know you, and you may not do this".
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`: whoever holds the token is authenticated, like a key. Always over HTTPS.
Role-based access control: permissions attached to roles (`admin`, `member`), roles attached to users.
Broken object level authorization: changing `/posts/1` to `/posts/2` reaches someone else's data because ownership is not checked. #1 in the OWASP API Top 10.
When in doubt (missing header, lookup error), deny. Protected by default, opened explicitly.
`c.set('user', user)` in a middleware and `c.get('user')` in handlers, typed with `Hono<{ Variables: ... }>`.
